clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares a poison for the Royal Apothecary Society. He wants to know how swiftly it kills before using it more widely.

Apothecary Lydon works in Tarren Mill to make chemical weapons for the Dark Lady's ambitions. His blight is meant to destroy both the living humans of the Alliance and the undead horrors of the Scourge. Once he has the needed reagents, Lydon mixes them into a foul brew he calls the Elixir of Suffering. He is eager to see its power before the Society uses it on a wider scale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.
There we go! Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.
Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.
Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
